PostToolUse.command: bash -c '"$HOME/.venv/bin/bandit" -q -lll -r . -x ./.venv,./.local,./.cache,./.npm,./.gemini,./reference_standards,./workspace_resources,./node_modules,./.git || exit 1; FACTORY_VAL=$(find . \( -name .venv -o -name .local -o -name .cache -o -name .npm -o -name .gemini -o -name reference_standards -o -name workspace_resources -o -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -name validate_registers.py -print | head -n 1); if [ -n "$FACTORY_VAL" ]; then "$HOME/.venv/bin/python" "$FACTORY_VAL" || exit 1; fi; PIM_VAL=$(find . \( -name .venv -o -name .local -o -name .cache -o -name .npm -o -name .gemini -o -name reference_standards -o -name workspace_resources -o -name node_modules -o -name .git \) -prune -o -name qa_verify.js -print | head -n 1); if [ -n "$PIM_VAL" ]; then node "$PIM_VAL" || exit 1; fi'
